jobs.occupation: Simulation & Modelling Engineer (d/f/m) (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to Friedrichshafen, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a Simulation & Modelling Engineer (d/f/m).

The Simulation & Modelling division includes departments in the UK, France and Germany and represents a core competence for simulator development for spacecraft platforms, payloads and equipment.

In the area of simulators, the department is responsible for producing the infrastructure that enables successful spacecraft avionics programs. Therefore, the department is looking for an experienced, talented and creative Simulation & Modelling Engineer (d/f/m) who is flexible, self-motivated and hardworking.

Your location

At the Airbus site in Friedrichshafen you will be working on innovation where others spend their holidays. Enjoy panoramic views of Lake Constance while having lunch in our canteen. And after work, join one of our many corporate sports groups to go running, sailing or skiing.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and special payments
- 30 days holidays and extra days-off for special occasions
- Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects
- Special benefits: employer-funded pension, employee stock options, discounted car leasing, special conditions for insurances, transportation subsidy, employee benefits at cooperating companies
- On-site-facilities: Kindergarten close to the site, medical officer for check-ups and other health-related services, lakeview canteen and cafeteria
- Company sports and leisure activities such as sailing, diving and flight simulation

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Design and development of simulators and simulation models for satellite systems.
- Creation of test procedures and test plans.
- Implementation and execution of automatic and manual component-tests, integration-tests and system-tests.
- Definition and creation of software releases.
- Provide support to the simulator users

Desired skills and qualifications

- Degree in computer science, software engineering or related discipline.
- Experience in Simulation and Modelling.
- Object Oriented analysis & design using UML (or similar)
- Experience in the development of desktop tools using a client/server architecture.
- Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills in English.
- Knowledge of machine-to-machine communication protocols
- Strong software development process knowledge
- A good knowledge of development domains, frameworks and utilities (DevOps)
- Excellent Knowledge on C++ & Java
- Experience working with Unix/Linux and Windows Operating Systems
- Will be positively considered experience on: SpaceWire, MilSTD 1553, ECSS PUS, CAN, Knowledge in spacecraft avionics systems, Knowledge in design of numerical and hybrid simulators design, Experience in Simulation and Modelling

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.occupation: Transformation and Change Management Specialist (f/m/d) (Einkäufer/in)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Transformation and Change Management (f/m/d) Specialist, you will work at the intersection of business transformation, AI deployment, and organizational change. On any given day, you may align with business leaders on upcoming AI rollouts, develop strategies to increase adoption of new digital solutions, coach stakeholders through change, and collaborate with Industrialized Rollout teams to ensure transformation activities are seamlessly integrated into deployment plans. You will monitor adoption trends, identify risks and barriers, and translate insights into actionable recommendations that accelerate business value realization. A key part of your role will be establishing scalable change management standards, tools, and governance approaches that enable consistent execution across multiple transformation initiatives. Ultimately, you will help ensure that AI-driven change is not only deployed successfully, but embraced, embedded, and sustained across Procurement.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Leadership of the people and organizational aspects of AI-enabled transformation initiatives, ensuring sustainable adoption of new ways of working
* Development and execution of change strategies to drive business readiness, stakeholder alignment, and behavioral change
* Establishment and continuous improvement of a standardized change management framework, including tools, governance, and success measures
* Integration of change management activities into deployment plans in collaboration with rollout leads, business leaders, and AI product teams
* Definition and monitoring of adoption metrics, business readiness, user adoption, risks, and value realization across rollout waves
* Identification of adoption barriers, consolidation of lessons learned, and implementation of continuous improvement measures to maximize transformation outcomes

What You Bring

* Master’s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Organizational Development, or a similar field
* Extensive experience in Change Management, Business Transformation, Organizational Development, or Digital Transformation, including IT tool implementations such as SAP Ariba or Workday
* Proven track record in leading large-scale transformation programs across functions, regions, and business units, including organizational and cultural transformation
* Demonstrated experience in driving adoption of new technologies, digital solutions, and automation initiatives, including the development of training and communication materials
* Strong expertise in senior stakeholder management, organizational change, operating model transformation, and business process improvement, ideally within a consulting environment
* Fluent in German and English (C2 level)

About the Team

You will join an Organization and Workforce Transformation team within Procurement that combines strategy and execution. We design future‑oriented concepts, but we also take responsibility for making them work in practice. Collaboration, trust, and a strong sense of ownership define how we work together. If you enjoy building something meaningful with real impact, you will feel at home here.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

jobs.occupation: Senior Software Engineer – Flash (f/m/d) (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
About Us

What if your work could drive change in a globally established industry, shaping processes that touch every corner of the world? At Forto, we are at the forefront of change, harnessing the power of AI to revolutionise logistics. We want to reinvent digital supply chains to be transparent, frictionless and sustainable. From day one, our mission has been to simplify global trade – creating a seamless and efficient logistics process.

Your Role & Mission

The mission of the Flash team at Forto is to fundamentally redesign operations processes by leveraging automation and intelligent decision-making to handle shipments more efficiently. We aim to scale CoPilot so that it becomes the primary system used by operations managers, enabling them to be more effective and efficient in their daily work.

As a Senior Software Engineer in the Flash team, you will help build AI-driven solutions and the CoPilot that powers our logistics operations. You will maintain and evolve a sophisticated event-driven, distributed architecture designed to answer one key question:

How do we improve shipment handling and bring efficiency to our operations teams at scale?

From quotation and rate management, to shipment execution and schedule optimization (capacity utilization and GP optimization), to carrier integrations and automated data extraction from unstructured sources (emails, PDFs, spreadsheets), this role focuses on building reliable, data-heavy systems that directly impact revenue and operational performance.

What you will do

- Design, build, and evolve scalable and resilient backend systems
- Contribute to an event-driven, distributed architecture
- Work on AI-adjacent systems (integration, orchestration, data-heavy workflows)
- Own services end-to-end (design, implementation, documentation, operation)
- Collaborate closely with product managers, operations, and other engineers
- Communicate clearly with stakeholders and explain technical trade-offs
- Contribute to technical standards and best practices within the team
- Foster a culture of excellence by coaching team members in best practices for backend engineering, domain-driven design, and navigating the complexities of the logistics domain.

Required Skills and Experience

- Strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, and complexity analysis, particularly as they apply to large-scale data processing and financial calculations.
- Proven professional software craftsmanship, with a focus on building high-quality, maintainable, and testable code (an understanding of TDD is a plus).
- Expertise in designing and implementing large-scale, event-driven microservices architectures and robust APIs, with a keen understanding of data consistency in distributed systems.
- Deep understanding of synchronous vs. asynchronous communication patterns and their impact on system performance and reliability
- Hands-on experience developing distributed backend applications, with a strong focus on data consistency, system quality, low latency, and high availability.
- Proficiency in microservices, with hands-on experience in backend technologies such as Node.js, TypeScript, and MongoDB.
- Familiarity with Kubernetes and container orchestration for deploying and managing scalable pricing services.
- Experience with cloud providers (AWS or GCP preferred) for deploying and managing highly available and scalable applications.
- A collaborative, team-oriented mindset with strong critical product thinking and a sense of ownership over the accuracy and effectiveness of pricing data.
- Fluent in English, both verbal and written, for effective communication within a global team.

Preferred Skills and Experience

- Experience integrating AI/LLM-powered features into user faced applications
- Experience applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) in complex product domains

Don’t fit all of our criteria? That’s okay! We know that you might be hesitant to apply if you don’t meet all our requirements, but here at Forto, we pride ourselves on embracing diverse perspectives and celebrating potential. If you are passionate about this position and the Forto values, please apply anyway. There could be a place for you in this role – or another one that’s a perfect fit! 

Why work with us?

Our team is hard-working, constantly seeking to maximise the impact of their work, but we put our people first, always winning with care. We value efficient systems and swift, direct communication. We want everyone to have their time to speak, so that we can embrace diverse perspectives to help drive towards solutions always.

Job description

Be a Founding Member of our New Connectivity Design Hub in Manching

Help us build the "Manching Footprint" of Connectivity & Comms. We are looking for a Senior Comms Engineer/Architect/Lead who thrives in "Brand New" environments. Based in our new Manching Design Office, you will take the lead on end-to-end development—from first concept to final qualification of all Connectivity Systems such as Tactical Datalinks (as but not only L-16), Comms Managers, IFDL, IVDL, CCAs C2 links for Air Power products such as Fighters, FCAS, CCAs, MuT, A400M…

Why this is different: This is the birth of our "Manching Team." You have the rare chance to bridge two worlds: the deep, established expertise of our Connectivity domain and the fresh, high-stakes opportunities emerging from new programs in Manching. You aren't just joining a legacy; you are scaling it into a new big team full of professional opportunities.

However, for all that, we need a skilful professional with proven knowledge in (some of) Systems Engineering or Connectivity, Tactical DataLinks, Satcom, Architectures definition, ready to be fully empowered and taking ownership of all Integration and Design Activities always paying attention to the future by means of innovation and R&T.

The Reward: A clear development path in a high-visibility, innovative discipline reporting directly to the HO Domain.

Ready for the challenge?

** Your location**

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

** Our Benefits for You**

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your Tasks and Responsibilities

- Definition and Design of the Connectivity architecture
- Support Customer (German mainly) meetings, Top Level requirements generation
- Alignment with Domain Connectivity Strategy considering National Programs specific requirements
- Suppliers Selection, RFP and RFI generation and analysis together with Procurement
- L1/L2/L3 Requirement definition and validation

jobs.occupation: Senior Automotive Security Engineer (f/m/x) (Ingenieur/in - Fahrzeugtechnik)
jobs.description:
Stellenreferenz: 194941

Mit unseren Marken BMW, MINI, Rolls-Royce und BMW Motorrad sind wir einer der weltweit führenden Premium-Hersteller von Automobilen sowie Motorrädern und darüber hinaus Anbieter von Premium-Finanz- und Mobilitätsdienstleistungen.

Our team is shaping the future of AI-powered cybersecurity solutions in the automotive domain. By combining deep expertise in embedded systems and vehicle E/E architectures with state-of-the-art AI technologies, we continuously advance the quality and effectiveness of automated security analyses.

What awaits you?

- You build, operate, and continuously evolve HPC and GPU cluster environments that enable state-of-the-art AI applications.
- You review and validate AI-generated findings from automated source code analyses of embedded systems and vehicle E/E architectures, ensuring their technical accuracy and relevance.
- You assess identified findings for plausibility, severity, and security-related impact.
- By analyzing and classifying false positives, you make a significant contribution to continuously improving the quality of security analysis results.
- Based on your assessments, you derive actionable recommendations for enhancing AI models, harnesses, skills, and analysis methodologies.
- You actively contribute to the optimization of analysis prompts, evaluation logic, and AI-driven security processes.
- As a trusted expert, you advise development and security teams on the interpretation of analysis results and support the implementation of effective remediation measures.

What should you bring along?

- University degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a comparable qualification.
- At least five years of professional experience in embedded software development or embedded systems architecture.
- Strong knowledge of automotive E/E architectures and systems.
- Hands-on experience in source code auditing or security-focused code analysis.
- Experience using AI-powered tools for source code analysis.
- Proven ability to assess security-critical software functions and architectures.
- Business-fluent English language skills; German language skills are desirable.

Are you passionate about analyzing complex security challenges and helping shape the next generation of AI-based cybersecurity solutions for the automotive industry? Apply now!

Note: Please apply exclusively online via our career portal. Applications via other channels (esp. e-mail) cannot be considered.

What we offer?

- Challenging projects with which we are shaping the mobility of tomorrow together.
- Wide range of personal and professional development opportunities.
- Attractive, fair and performance-related remuneration.
- High level of job security.
- Annual special payments such as vacation pay, Christmas bonus, and profit sharing.
- Flexible working hours including 6 weeks annual leave and overtime compensation.
- Discounted BMW & MINI conditions.
- Many other benefits at  bmw.jobs/benefits

Start date:  from now on
Working hours:  fulltime

If you apply, the next stages of the recruiting process include online testing and an interview with the hiring manager (either virtual or in person).
